rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name + zip and worked on the correct user’s orders. However, it attempted multiple order modifications without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation to proceed (required before any write). It also did not verify the order status of #W3361211 prior to attempting modifications, as required to ensure eligibility. When the user opted to cancel, the agent proceeded after asking for a reason but did not restate the exact action for confirmation. Additionally, the stated refund timeline (5–7 business days) was not supported by the tools. Although the final outcome (order cancellation) matched the user’s last request, these policy lapses (notably attempting writes without explicit confirmation and not checking status) fail the pass bar.
